body.p: An Evenki with a motley face. There are two tents. In one tent, a man lives, his wife lives, they have two children. In the other tent, an old man lives, this old man has two wives. Sometimes men go hunting, they go looking for wild reindeer. Once in autumn, the men again went to chase wild reindeer, after all. They haven't been home for a few days. Once the wife of an old man went for water. She reached the river and scooped some water. She just went towards her tent. She goes towards the tent. Suddenly, it is heard someone is walking behind the bush. After that, a part of a motley face appeared from there. "Oh, it's a Tungus with a colourful face, obviously", - the woman thought to herself. She got very scared and ran towards her tent. At home, she said to her friends: "I saw there, behind the bushes, a motley face. Let us avoid being killed while the men are away, it would be good to spend nights in the same tent." The neighbours said: "Oh, you are always afraid of something, did it seem to you, apparently?" Well. The neighbour woman with her children stayed in her tent.[ShA:] N'iza is an unexpected form here, n'ita is expected. And the two women did this: one woman hid under the pillows, the other, the old one, hid near the door and is waiting for the Tungus with a mottled face holding an ax. Oh, some time later they heard a cry from the neighbouring tent, then the cry stopped. The old woman is waiting and holding the ax. Suddenly it is heard someone is walking outside. Then the head appeared through the doorway. His face is all painted, he started to blow the fire. His head is twirling at the two sides. The old woman jumped up, and chopped him with an axe from head to toe. While chopping, she said only: "You shit, blow the fire, you shit, blow the fire!" The men came the next day. Oh, in another tent everyone was killed.
